For example, if the CanIf module is referenced then the PDU Router module will implement the PduR_CanIfRxIndication API. And the PDUR module will call the CanIf_Transmit API. Other APIs are of course also covered. An upper module can also be an lower module (e.g. the IpduM module). This parameter might be set to false if the retransmission feature is not used, even though the destination transport protocol is supporting it. This parameter is only valid for transport protocol modules and gateway operations. If transmission from a local upper layer module this module will handle the retransmission.
